rationale: The assistant correctly framed this as normal heat-pump behaviour from the first reply, explained that heat pump dryers 'run much cooler and slower', and focused on the right discriminator ('still properly damp at the end'). It used the customer's answers faithfully (full drum, door opening, filters cleaned) and gave a sensible comparison test with no parts and only a conditional, correctly placed warranty escalation. The main gap is that it never asked about the dryer's location/room temperature, which was the biggest hidden factor (unheated garage at 8-10 C), and step 3 of the final reply somewhat redundantly re-suggests cleaning the heat-exchanger filter the customer had already said was clean.
